Hi Quinn,

Thanks for reaching out about Invoice #60685. I’m happy to clarify how seat billing works for DataBridge Pro.

1. **What counts as a seat?**
   A seat is any user account that was active (logged in or made an API call) at least once during the billing month. Seats are tallied at the end of the month.

2. **Why were we billed for 298 seats?**
   The invoice reflects the total number of seats that were active at any point in the billing period. Even if a user was de‑activated later in the month, the seat remains counted for that month.

3. **Can we receive a credit for the 11 seats we didn’t use?**
   Credits for seat over‑ages can be requested if the over‑provisioned seats were never activated during the month. Please submit a credit request within 30 days of the invoice date by navigating to Settings → Billing → Request Credit and include the invoice number and a brief explanation. Our billing team will review the request and get back to you.

If you have any additional questions or need help submitting the credit request, just let me know.

Best regards,
[Your Name] – Customer Support
